work.abstract_text: We answer the realizability question of Vélez Caicedo and Cadavid (§5, p. 17, second paragraph of arXiv:2611.14316v1) by reflecting semigroup generators about a prescribed maximum jump: every numerical semigroup T is realizable, and a positive integer M is an admissible maximum exactly when M belongs to T and every minimal generator h satisfies h<2M and 2M-h belongs to T. The construction gives the unique inclusion-minimal jump set at each admissible maximum and realizes every sufficiently large maximum. Using the source's spectral formulas, we also recover the semigroup from two global dimensions and M-2 restricted dimensions when M>=2. For prime maxima, eventual dimensions at proper-divisor moduli alone need not distinguish semigroups.

work.title: Vélez Caicedo and Cadavid's numerical-semigroup realizability question: prescribed maxima and reduced spectral data
